pages.text: $(l)Built, fuelled, but nothing turns - $(item)No redstone signal$():$() a small engine never runs on fuel alone. Signal 0 means 0 RPM. Put a lever or any redstone source against any block of it. $(li)$(item)Exhaust full$():

the engine filled its 8000 mB CO2 tank and stopped. Pump the CO2 into an Exhaust block. $(li)$(item)Wrong fuel$(): the fuel must be in the list on the cylinders' tooltip. $(li)$(item)No output shaft$(): a regular engine needs a shaft clicked onto an end block.

$(l)Engine with a controller ignores redstone$()$(br)That is expected: a linked transmission hands control to the engine controller. Start the engine with the start key, or take the transmission off with a wrench.

$(l)Engine row splits$()$(br)Blocks only join when they are the same block, face the same way and share the same type, up to 5 blocks by default. A sixth block starts a new engine.$(br2)$(l)Upgrade refused$()$(br)Each block takes one upgrade, and the same upgrade only once per engine.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
